verdicts.title: Tight Correlation Bounds for Circuits Between AC0 and TC0
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We initiate the study of generalized AC0 circuits comprised of negations and arbitrary unbounded fan-in gates that only need to be constant over inputs of Hamming weight $\ge k$, which we denote GC0$(k)$. verdicts.title: Double groupoids and homotopy 2-types
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This work contributes to clarifying several relationships between certain higher categorical structures and the homotopy types of their classifying spaces.
